edges.reason: msg.sender is the poolWithdraw beneficiary and is marked withdrawn only after external token transfers
msg.sender owns the staged balance and receives the withdrawn value
commit is protected by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner()
changeOwner is protected by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner()
burn is protected by onlyV2Migrator which compares msg.sender to v2Migrator()
msg.sender is the coupon holder whose underlying is decremented and who receives minted dollar
msg.sender is the coupon allowance owner being approved from
msg.sender may be the spender consuming another account coupon allowance
redeemCoupons validity depends on epoch(), which is derived from block.timestamp via blockTimestamp()
external univ2 transfer occurs before the withdrawn flag is set, enabling reentrant poolWithdraw
external dollar transfer occurs before the withdrawn flag is set, enabling reentrant poolWithdraw
dollar transfer executes before the staged balance is decremented, allowing reentrant withdraw
incentivize triggers an external dollar mint to the target account
redeemCoupons triggers an external dollar mint to the caller
owner-only commit routes into upgradeTo with the candidate address
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on the newly supplied implementation
setImplementation writes the implementation pointer through assembly sstore
initialize triggers external pool emergencyWithdraw draining dollar and univ2
poolMarkWithdrawn is executed after the external transfers, leaving a reentrancy window
poolWithdraw decrements pool dollar withdrawable after transferring dollar
poolWithdraw reads withdrawable amounts from poolWithdrawable
withdraw decrements the caller staged balance after the token transfer
burn decrements the account balance and total supply
redeemCoupons decrements coupon underlying of the caller
approveCoupons writes the coupon allowance
transferCoupons decrements the sender coupon underlying
transferCoupons increments the recipient coupon underlying
transferCoupons decrements the coupon allowance when msg.sender is not the sender
incentivizeWithStake increments the account balance
initialize incentivizes the committer with minted dollar
initialize incentivizes the dev address with staked balance
initialize snapshots the pool total rewarded
initialize snapshots the pool dollar withdrawable balance
initialize sets the owner slot to the V2 DAO address, taking control of the contract
decrementBalanceOf reads and writes _state account balance and supply
incrementBalanceOf reads and writes _state account balance and supply
decrementBalanceOfStaged reads and writes _state staged balances
incrementBalanceOfCouponUnderlying writes _state coupon allowance mapping
updateAllowanceCoupons writes the _state coupon allowance mapping
decrementAllowanceCoupons reads and writes the _state coupon allowance mapping
incrementBalanceOfCouponUnderlying reads and writes _state16 coupon underlying
decrementBalanceOfCouponUnderlying reads and writes _state16 coupon underlying
poolMarkWithdrawn writes the _state25 poolWithdrawn mapping
setOwner writes the _state25 owner field
snapshotPoolTotalRewarded writes _state25 poolTotalRewarded
snapshotPoolTotalDollar writes _state25 poolDollarWithdrawable
decrementPoolDollarWithdrawable reads and writes _state25 poolDollarWithdrawable
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant is used as the sstore slot for the implementation pointer
burn account argument selects the balance mapping entry to decrement
burn amount is subtracted via SafeMath sub, arithmetic-sensitive value
withdraw value is subtracted from staged balance via SafeMath sub
couponEpoch participates in epoch().sub(couponEpoch) arithmetic
redeem amount is subtracted from coupon underlying and minted
spender argument is the allowance target in approveCoupons
amount argument is the allowance value in approveCoupons
sender argument selects the coupon owner being debited
recipient argument selects the coupon receiver being credited
epoch argument selects the coupon epoch mapping slot
amount argument is added/subtracted from coupon underlying via SafeMath
candidate argument becomes the new implementation address chosen by the owner
newOwner argument is written to the privileged owner slot
newImplementation argument is stored and delegatecalled by upgradeTo
newImplementation is the target of the delegatecall inside upgradeTo
univ2Amount local is passed as the value of the univ2 transfer
dollarAmount local is passed as the value of the dollar transfer
poolWithdraw derives univ2Amount from poolWithdrawable
poolWithdraw derives dollarAmount from poolWithdrawable

normalization_plan.reason: account parameter has no independent security meaning outside burn
amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath sub inside burn
value parameter only feeds the staged balance decrement inside withdraw
couponEpoch parameter only feeds the epoch comparison inside redeemCoupons
amount parameter only feeds the coupon underlying decrement and mint in redeemCoupons
spender parameter only feeds the allowance update in approveCoupons
amount parameter only feeds the allowance update in approveCoupons
sender parameter only feeds the coupon debit inside transferCoupons
recipient parameter only feeds the coupon credit inside transferCoupons
epoch parameter only selects the coupon mapping slot inside transferCoupons
amount parameter only feeds the coupon underlying arithmetic inside transferCoupons
candidate parameter only feeds the privileged upgrade path in commit
newOwner parameter only feeds the privileged owner write in changeOwner
newImplementation parameter only feeds the delegatecall and storage write in upgradeTo
univ2Amount local is only used as the amount of the univ2 transfer
dollarAmount local is only used as the amount of the dollar transfer
